summary: A checkpoint, shared or local, now keeps the observation a mission request names as its discovery, as it already keeps claims cited as evidence or pinned as a run input. Many requests do not cite their discovery in evidence, so the newest-only rule for observer resource observations could have dropped one the reconciler still reads by its ID. Checkpoint rules move to version 22

replay.detail: No claim is written or read differently; a checkpoint only keeps more.

rules.detail: RULES_VERSION 22 adds the request-discovery guard. Members agree on a shared checkpoint only when they run the same rules, so a member on version 21 and one on 22 hold shared checkpoints until both run 22. A member that trims locally plans its own cut and is not held.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade.

recovery.detail: Reverting returns to version 21, under which a checkpoint may drop a superseded discovery that no request cites as evidence.
